title: Write on a Scroll
body:
Syntax: write <scroll name>

Write your own multi-line message on an Info Scroll from a village general store. Jutsu-learning scrolls cannot be written on. The familiar room-description editor opens. Type text and use '.' or '/s' to save, '/a' to abort, '/c' to clear, '/l' to list. Maximum 2,500 characters or 35 lines. Each physical written scroll keeps its own message through giving, dropping, trading and restarts. Anyone can read the message with 'examine <scroll>', regardless of their Examine skill. A technique scroll still teaches its jutsu via 'read <scroll>', which consumes it on successful learning.
